Main single-GPU serial phase admission correction — 2026-10-13

First actual phase process (model lifetime root v1) loaded weights/Arena, then rejected startup before READY or any GEN. Original passed=false/complete=false and protocol observation error remain unchanged. Engine exit1, direct child reaped, session empty, no fallback signals; fresh kernel faults0/devcoredump absent. This was an admission bug, not a GPU hang.

Options::pipeline_windows defaults0. It means explicitly overlapped multiGPU window mode when>0; parser/config validation around generate.cpp2661-2674 disables it without a qualified two-GPU/MTP setup. Phase singleGPU/noMTP was incorrectly requiring1, making its envelope contradictory. Main fixes the sole predicate to require0 and diagnostic text pipeline0. Existing raw stock argv used default0, raw --spec4/noMTP/suffix0 gives effectiveT1. Historical metadata saying pipeline1 meant serial one-window execution, not actual CLI1; historical receipts are not rewritten.

Main mirrored the two-line guard correction into the unqualified head-lease worktree without changing its lease operations. Required free/contrib-llvm engine rebuild is in new v6 receipt. Untouched Release/ASan/server/real tiny VMM fixtures retain prior proof and byte-identical hashes; affected generator lints are rechecked against the actual pristine baseline, inheriting the completed full source/doc checks. No checks disabled. New model v2 is a fresh output and explicit --pipeline-windows0, after checks; no speed/quality/full256K claim. Performance remains unchanged upstream bench.sh.
